# Claude Skill POCs

This directory contains proof-of-concept experiments with Claude Code skills.

The generated files here are outputs produced by invoking Claude skills — each file is the result of using a skill to generate content rather than writing it manually.

## Generated Files

| File | Skill Used | Description |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| `addition.py` | `write-python-fn` | Python addition function with type hints, main caller, and pytest tests |
